2026-09-08.html:
今日 IELTS 词汇复习

1. undermine

undermine = 削弱，损害

Chunk

undermine sb's ability to do sth
= 削弱某人做某事的能力

Sentence

Chronic sleep deprivation may undermine students' ability to concentrate.

长期睡眠不足可能削弱学生集中注意力的能力。

2. enhance

enhance = 提高，增强

Chunk

enhance academic performance
= 提高学业表现

Sentence

Regular exercise can enhance students' academic performance.

规律运动可以提高学生的学业表现。

3. significant

significant = 显著的；重要的

Chunk

have a significant impact on sth
= 对……产生显著影响

Sentence

Technological progress has a significant impact on modern education.

科技进步对现代教育产生了显著影响。

4. allocate

allocate = 分配

Chunk

allocate funding to sth
= 为……分配资金

Sentence

The government should allocate more funding to improve public transport.

政府应该投入更多资金改善公共交通。

5. inevitable

inevitable = 不可避免的

Chunk

become inevitable
= 变得不可避免

Sentence

As urban populations continue to grow, traffic congestion may become inevitable.

随着城市人口持续增长，交通拥堵可能变得不可避免。

6. chronic

chronic = 长期的；慢性的；持续存在的

Chunk

chronic sleep deprivation
= 长期睡眠不足

Sentence

Chronic sleep deprivation may undermine students' ability to concentrate.

长期睡眠不足可能削弱学生集中注意力的能力。

今天额外学到的高价值 Chunk

chronic sleep deprivation
长期睡眠不足

ability to concentrate
集中注意力的能力

academic performance
学业表现

technological progress
科技进步

public transport
公共交通

urban populations
城市人口

traffic congestion
交通拥堵

continue to grow
持续增长

今天的易错点

❌ ability of doing
✅ ability to do

❌ put a significant impact on
✅ have a significant impact on

❌ may becomes
✅ may become

❌ more and more inevitable
✅ become inevitable

❌ study performance
✅ academic performance

❌ lack sleep / lacking sleep
✅ lack of sleep / sleep deprivation

明天重点回忆

不要只背单词，要把它们和搭配一起回忆：

undermine → ability
enhance → performance
significant → impact
allocate → funding
inevitable → become
chronic → sleep deprivation

目标是看到左边，就能立刻说出右边。

2026-09-07.html:
形容词词缀 + 词根 + 完整例句（全量版）
---
一、-ous（充满/具有）
· enormous (norm=标准)：The internet has exerted （施加，尽力）an enormous impact on global communication.
· precarious (prec=恳求)：Gig workers often live in precarious conditions without job security.
· indigenous (gen=出生)：Protecting indigenous languages is crucial for cultural diversity（文化多样性）.
· scrupulous (scrup=尖石)：A scrupulous researcher double-checks（仔细检查） all data before publication.
· fabulous (fabul=传说)：The view from the mountain top was absolutely fabulous.
· fatuous (fatu=空洞)：His fatuous remarks added nothing to the serious debate.

二、-able/-ible（值得/能够）
· delectable (lect=挑选)：The city is famous for its delectable street food.
· viable (viv=活)：Solar energy is now a viable alternative to fossil fuels.

三、-ent/-ant（状态）
· significant (sign+fic=做标记)：There is a significant correlation between pollution and respiratory diseases.
· constant (st=站立)：The constant connectivity of smartphones blurs work-life boundaries.
· dominant (domin=统治)：English remains the dominant language in international business.
· predominant (domin=统治)：The predominant reason for migration is economic opportunity.
· convenient (ven=来)：Online banking is a convenient way to manage personal finances.

四、-ive（倾向/作用）
· compulsive (puls=推)：Excessive social media use can develop into compulsive behaviour.
· effective (fect=做)：Education is the most effective tool to combat inequality.
· massive (mass=块)：The project required a massive amount of capital investment.

五、-al（与...有关）
· rational (ratio=计算)：Consumers do not always make rational decisions; emotions play a big role.
· hereditary (hered=继承)：Some diseases are hereditary, while others are triggered by lifestyle.
· traditional (trad=传承)：Traditional diets are often healthier than processed foods.

六、-ory/-ary（相关/倾向）
· compulsory (puls=推)：Physical education should be compulsory in all schools.
· sanitary (san=健康)：Providing sanitary living conditions is a basic government responsibility.

七、-ic（属于/特征）
· archaic (arch=开端)：The country's legal system is archaic and needs urgent reform.
· phonetic (phon=声音)：Using phonetic symbols helps learners master pronunciation.

---

⚡ 词根串烧（速记）

· norm（标准）→ 超标准 = enormous
· domin（统治）→ 主导 = dominant，压倒 = predominant
· puls（推）→ 外界推 = compulsory，内心推 = compulsive
· gen（出生）→ 本地 = indigenous，基因 = genetics

---

口诀：-ous特质多，-able能做，-ent稳，-ive倾向，-al相关。每个词都有例句，放心背！😊
